participation.context: Named Tuesday, refused to give up the part, and left.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said the plot had him nowhere, kept the twelve pence off the share, and named the Rose title.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Left Monday's cut for Monday, and did not take a roll.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

relations.note: Cowley is not covering him, and is not asking for the cut
relations.quote: I am not asking you which cut stands.

story.body: You gave them Tuesday at ten. You did not hand Cowley a part. You did not stay for the afternoon. You went home.

title: Told John Tuesday at ten and went home
